tools.name: purchaseElicitation
tools.description: Interactive, stateful endpoint to guide small-footprint AI agents through a purchase flow for gift cards or mobile top-ups. Call repeatedly with the same session_token until 'status' is 'complete' or 'error'. For the first call, provide an empty 'body': {} (session_token will be generated and return

tools.name: listBrands
tools.description: Fetch available gift-card and mobile top-ups brands for a given country

tools.name: listProductsForCountry
tools.description: List all products in a country, optionally filtering by brand, family, coin, payment method, or language

tools.name: getPaymentViasWithCurrencies
tools.description: Fetch possible payment methods and supported currencies/networks

tools.name: getProductPrice
tools.description: Get pricing for range-based products where customer can select face value within min/max range

tools.name: validateOrder
tools.description: Validate a potential order against minimum amount and business rules

tools.name: createOrder
tools.description: Submit a new order with selected products and payment method. The response carries order_id and order_token: keep both. order_token is returned only here, cannot be recovered, and getOrderStatus requires it to check the order later.

tools.name: getOrderStatus
tools.description: Retrieve the status and details of a submitted order. Requires order_id and the order_token returned by createOrder (or by purchaseElicitation on completion).

tools.name: searchProducts
tools.description: Search products by text query across brands and categories in a given country

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "createOrder" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Submit a new order with selected products and payment method" → after: "Submit a new order with selected products and payment method. The response carries order_id and order_token: keep both. order_token is returned only here, cannot be recovered, and getOrderStatus requires it to check the order later."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
